confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and cappuccino anchors come from crowd-sourced cost-of-living figures found by search. Numbeo data dated June 2026 gave an inexpensive meal at about EUR 16.66, a mid-range meal for two at EUR 75.49 and a 0.5 L draft beer at EUR 5.21. MyLifeElsewhere put a cappuccino at about EUR 4.16. These were converted at about 1.10 USD per EUR, using the RBA's 18 Nov 2026 AUD rates for USD and EUR. That conversion uses a November rate for July 2026 prices, so it adds some uncertainty. The cocktail and wine prices were not searched directly. They are estimated from how drink prices usually compare to beer in Austria, so they are less certain. Accommodation is a general-knowledge model estimate for the July summer peak and was not checked against live listings. Innsbruck has a small hostel market, so the hostel anchors are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Innsbruck is a mid-sized Alpine tourist city whose restaurant prices run slightly above the Austrian average. Accommodation was benchmarked against Salzburg and the lower end of Vienna for the summer high season.
